_readme: SISO Voice's own numbers for /voice/. Every figure carries its source; they describe our own use of Voice, not other users. Same figures as the blog post 'What we took from 25 voice apps' (siso/blog/posts.ts).

history.source: PipelineHistory.sqlite, 13 Aug to 6 Oct 2026: our own dictations (claim ledger voiceuse, voiceagt, OBS). Internal usage, not a survey.

research.source: Voice repository research, 23 Sep 2026: 16 dictation and 9 voice-to-agent repos on GitHub, plus an Aqua Voice teardown (claim ledger voicecmp, OBS).

lineage.name: FreeFlow
lineage.took: Hold a key, talk, and the words are typed where your cursor is.

lineage.name: voicemode
lineage.took: The idea of the agent talking back to you.

lineage.name: FluidVoice
lineage.took: Live captions, rebuilt on Apple's recognizer.

lineage_source: Claim ledger voicelin (OBS): base zachlatta/freeflow (MIT), talk-back from mbailey/voicemode (MIT), live captions rebuilt from FluidVoice's idea.
